title: Cerebus Jaka’s Story Epilogue 1 Aug #137 Aardvark-Vanaheim Comics 1990
descriptionText:
Cerebus Jaka’s Story Epilogue 1 Aug #137 is a classic comic book from Aardvark-Vanaheim, published in 1990. This issue features the artwork of Dave Sim and Gerhard and is part of the Copper Age (1984-1991) era of US Comics. The comic book is a collectible item for fans of the Cerebus the Aardvark series and those interested in the Comics genre.

The comic book is in good condition and is a great addition to any collection. It features the character Cerebus, a popular and iconic figure in the comics world. The publication year, artist/writer, type, issue number, and series title are also important aspects of this collectible item. Get your hands on this rare and unique piece of comic book history today!
